# Diwakar Ray Yadav

> BIT student in Kathmandu, Nepal. Growth Intern at Springbase AI. Tests new AI models by building things with them and writes about AI tools, models, and agents in plain English.

Diwakar started in office work (NEPSE share trading and IT support), moved into AI through The Mindsnack, and built Nepal AI Gateway, a free OpenAI-compatible AI API for developers in Nepal that needs no international card. He posts model tests and one-file Three.js builds on X as @Norwakar.

## Pages

- [Diwakar Ray Yadav | Portfolio](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/): Portfolio of Diwakar Ray Yadav, BIT student from Nepal and Growth Intern at Springbase AI. Building with LLMs, AI APIs, and modern AI tools.
- [About](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/about/): Diwakar Ray Yadav, a BIT student in Kathmandu, Nepal. Growth Intern at Springbase AI, builder of Nepal AI Gateway, and tests new AI models by building things with them.
- [Projects](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/projects/): Projects by Diwakar Ray Yadav: Nepal AI Gateway, SystemCleaner Pro, File Organizer, and AI builds made while testing new models.
- [AI Blog, Prompting Tips, and Free AI Tools](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/): AI blog by Diwakar Ray Yadav covering prompt engineering, free AI tools, agent platforms, and practical automation workflows.
- [Contact](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/contact/): Get in touch with Diwakar Ray Yadav for web development projects, collaborations, and AI opportunities.

## Blog posts

- [Your AI Coding Agent Needs a Leash: 3 Warnings From October 2026](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/ai-agent-security-october-2026/): Three October 2026 stories show why AI coding agents need limits: a model that tried to send data out, a hijacked CLI setup, and attackers using agents.
- [Apps Are Opening Their Doors to AI Agents: Apple, Walmart, and GitHub in October 2026](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/apps-opening-to-ai-agents/): Apple, Walmart, and GitHub opened official doors for AI agents in October 2026. What MCP is, what changes for users, and what builders should do next.
- [GPT-6, Claude 5.5, Gemini 4: The October 2026 Model Rush, Explained](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/october-2026-ai-models/): GPT-6, Claude 5.5 and Gemini 4 all landed within about a month. What each costs, what free users get, and which to try first if you build from Nepal.
- [Open Models in October 2026: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, and Mistral Close the Gap](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/open-weight-models-october-2026/): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3 and Mistral Large 4: what the October 2026 open models cost, what runs locally, and how to choose one.
- [10 Unconventional Simple Tool Ideas](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/simple-tool-ideas/): 10 unconventional simple tool ideas that solve problems hiding in plain sight - from time awareness to self-knowledge.
- [AI Myths I Tested: 5 Claims, and 4 Were Flat-Out False](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/ai-myths-tested/): Five common AI claims put to a hands-on test, with honest results: which held up, which failed, and what the gap between demo and reality really is.
- [Building in Public from Kathmandu: One Year of Shipping AI Projects](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/building-in-public-kathmandu/): A year-one retrospective on building and shipping AI projects in public from Kathmandu, with honest lessons on consistency, audience, and shipping ugly.
- [Prompt Engineering Is Dead. Here's What Replaced It](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/is-prompt-engineering-dead/): Why classic prompt engineering is fading and what replaced it: context engineering, evaluation, and knowing which model to use.
- [The Free AI Stack: Everything I Use Daily That Costs $0](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/free-ai-stack/): The exact set of free AI tools used daily for writing, coding, research, and image work, with honest notes on where the free tier stops being enough.
- [AI Agents Are Quietly Breaking the Old 'App' Model](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/what-are-ai-agents/): A plain-language explanation of what AI agents are, how they differ from chatbots, and why they are reshaping how software gets built.
- [Claude vs ChatGPT vs Gemini: 6 Months of Daily Use, Real Differences](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/claude-vs-chatgpt-vs-gemini/): A long-term, hands-on comparison of Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini after six months of daily use, covering writing, coding, search, and honesty.
- [How to Run an LLM on a Normal Laptop (No GPU, No PhD)](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/run-llm-locally/): A beginner-friendly tutorial for running a real LLM on a normal laptop with no graphics card, using Ollama and a quantized model.
- [I Tested 7 AI Coding Assistants So You Don't Have To](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/best-ai-coding-assistants/): A hands-on comparison of 7 AI coding assistants tested on the same real tasks, with honest strengths, weaknesses, and a final verdict.
- [Open-Weight vs Closed AI Models: Which Should You Actually Use?](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/open-vs-closed-models/): A practical decision guide for choosing open-weight vs closed AI models in 2026, based on cost, privacy, control, and what you actually ship.
- [Best Free AI Tools, LLMs, and Agent Platforms in 2026](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/trending-llms/): A practical list of free AI tools, LLMs, and agent platforms in 2026, including chatbots, OCR tools, research agents, and workflow assistants.
- [12 AI Prompting Tips for Better ChatGPT and Claude Results](https://www.diwakaryadav.com.np/blog/prompting-tips/): Learn 12 practical AI prompting tips to get better results from ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants.
